profile_selection: Explicit compile-time choice. No automatic switching by preset, pitch or macro.

events.gate: binary gate, rising edge retriggers; falling edge starts additional release
events.velocity: 0..1 linear amplitude, latched on rising gate

motion: 3 ms one-pole on normalized macros; pitch in log Hz; snap all controls to exact target at onset. No smoothing of gate/velocity.
gain: Fixed kernel level 0.6. No output normalization, limiter, EQ or reverb. Drive profiles need level-aware audition, not a promise of equal loudness.
incompatible_with: Not a replacement for existing Tracker IDs or frozen lab presets. 17 diagnostic controls are not all independently reachable from this eight-control manifold.
